common_callback_stack_pair_instructions.scope: Verified common entry and single common exit only, multiplied by exact successful callback counts. Other emitted instructions and counter noise are not attributed.

scope: Own static routine sizes and frames from actual bounded machine-code disassembly; dynamic counters from four identical successful diagnostic calls. The extra pair-store count covers the unconditional helper entry prologue only; it is not net whole-call instruction attribution, omits removed admission prologues and other offsets, and is not a speed forecast. Original split callback total is reconstructed from current logical visits and checked against the retained baseline protocol, not a newly rerun baseline census.
